niche: measurement-informed methane inventory of a gas producer's gathering systems, monthly aerial overflights reconciled with the routine-source factor inventory for a low-methane supply nomination
stakeholder_role: methane measurement lead at a natural gas producer

spine.file: state production reports by well and month
spine.entity: one unconventional well's gas, condensate and days on line in one reporting month, as the producer files it with the state
spine.source: synthetic (constructed in the layouts of a state oil and gas production report, an aerial methane survey vendor's detection and flight files, a maintenance system's work orders and a routine-source emissions inventory; no real producer, site or measurement is depicted)

world.geography: United States: southwestern Pennsylvania and northern West Virginia (Appalachian basin)

driver: Each scheduled visit records the rate of whatever is active at that moment, so a unit's yearly total from intermittent releases is its mean recorded rate across the visits times the hours in the year; booking each sighting as a release whose duration is assumed from the visit schedule and the follow-up record understates the short releases that end on their own and overstates the long ones fixed after a sighting, so units dominated by each kind cross a fixed cap in opposite directions.
driver_concrete: A gathering system's methane from large releases in the qualification year is each site's mean measured rate over the monthly overflights that covered it times the year's hours, summed over its sites; booking each detection from halfway since the site's last clean flight to the crew's repair, and dropping the detections the crew found already stopped, keeps only the stuck valves a crew fixed and misses most of the wet-gas systems' tank flashes and blowdowns, leaving two of them under the agreement's cap, which they exceed.
stump: The default path nominates five systems, two wet-gas systems among them, because it books each detection as a release lasting from halfway since the site's last clean flight to the crew's repair and drops the detections the crew found already stopped, which keeps only the releases a crew fixed and misses most of the short, self-ending tank flashes and blowdowns those systems carry (figures fixed at build).
analyst_test: With every field read right (a detection is a plume seen at a site at a flight's time, a work order records when the crew fixed the source or found it already stopped), the easy route books each detection as a release from midway since the site's last clean flight to the repair, drops the ones the crew could not find, and nominates the condensate systems whose measured intensity is above the cap.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each system's measurement-informed methane intensity, whose large-release part the field builds from repeated overflights as each source's mean measured rate times its persistence (the share of overflights that found it emitting), added to the routine-source factor inventory and divided by methane sold; with another field's nouns the plume detections above an aircraft's floor, the routine factor inventory and intensity against methane sold have no counterpart.
layer1: two survey vendors across the year, one reporting kilograms of methane an hour against site identifiers in UTC, the other standard cubic feet of whole gas an hour against coordinates in Eastern time
flight logs in which some sites were not flown in some months (airspace, weather, pads brought on line mid-year), so an absent detection is a clean flight only where the site was flown
a site register in which pads moved between gathering systems on an effective date
state production reports by well and month, with amended filings, rolled up to pads and systems
quarterly gas analyses by system giving the methane share of sales gas
maintenance work orders with free-text findings and local times
the routine-source inventory workbook (component counts by site times factors) with multi-row headers

differentiation.task126: task126 splits records a succession link wrongly joins into one unit; here no link is followed or split: the decisive move reads repeated scheduled snapshots as samples of time, so a site's yearly mass is its mean snapshot rate times the hours, against booking each sighting as a release with an assumed duration.

The ET07 seed's world (federal award reconciliation) sits honestly only in record linkage or administrative register quality, both banned by task448 and task449, so the draw is redone in the ETL objective on physical-environmental-sciences emissions-inventory (never drawn; PES x ETL never built). org_family other: a natural gas producer. The decisive step is the field's measurement-informed inventory method for intermittent large releases (rate times persistence from repeated overflights); grain_or_unit is the honest strategy (a detection row is a moment of a release, not a release) and draws the semantics-risk WARN, answered by the analyst test: every field is read right on the default path, which still files the wrong set. Detection probability is kept out of the decisive step (every large release sits above both vendors' floors, every routine site total below) so the build does not repeat task229 or task230.
